card.name: Spots right before the word solution
card.fires_on: Positions where the next word is likely 'solution' or a dissolving or oral-liquid form, such as partway through drug names, after 'tablet or', or at 'dissolve'. It also fires on odd spots in dosing and mixing text.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Partway through a brand or generic drug name in a passage that goes on to oral forms.
modes.example: For patients unable to safely and reliably swallow L<<AM>>IVUDINE tablets, the oral solution

modes.label: Dissolving and mixing steps
modes.description: At the start of 'dissolve' or 'disperse' in preparation instructions.
modes.example: If powder remains, repeat until the powder<< diss>>olves. The mixed solution may appear cloudy

modes.label: Tablet or liquid choice
modes.description: Linking words or punctuation in lists of tablet, suspension or solution forms.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing 'solution' and away from 'resolution' or 'resolve'.
card.plain: It lights up where the text is about to name a liquid solution or describe dissolving a medicine.
